effect.shortEffect: Other Pokémon cannot lower this Pokémon's stats.
effect.full: This Pokémon's stats cannot be lowered by other Pokémon's moves or abilities.  This effect only applies to normal stat modifications and not more exotic effects such as Topsy-Turvy or Power Swap. This Ability is not bypassed by Mold Breaker, Teravolt, or Turboblaze.
